blocks.content: The recommended tool for this procedure is a medium size flat-blade screwdriver.
The replacement parts for this procedure are:

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: CAUTION: Use  proper  ESD  grounding  techniques  when  handling  components. Wear an antistatic wrist strap and use an ESD-protected workstation. Store the PWA in an antistatic bag before placing it on any surface.

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: To replace the CPU PWA, see Figure 7-12 and Figure 7-13 , then proceed as follows:

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: Turn off the infuser and disconnect the device from AC power.

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: Remove the battery as described in Section 7.2.4 .

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: Separate  the  front  enclosure,  rear  enclosure,  and  main  chassis  assembly as described in Section 7.2.8 .

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: Remove the power supply PWA as described in Section 7.2.12.1 .

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: Remove the display assembly as described in Section 7.2.12.3 .

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: Using the flat blade screwdriver, remove the two screws that secure the CPU PWA to the main chassis.

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: Install the replacement CPU PWA in the exact reverse order of removal.

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: Reassemble the keypad, display assembly, CPU PWA, and power supply PWA.

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: Join the front enclosure, rear enclosure, and main chassis assembly in the exact reverse order of separation.

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: Reinstall the battery and connect the device to AC power.

blocks.section: PWA, CPU Screw, 4-40 x 1/4, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer
blocks.content: To verify successful CPU PWA replacement, perform the PVT in Section 5.2 .
